rationale: Genome-wide screen (Brie-type mouse library, 4 guides per gene, no non-targeting guides) in Cas9 Cd11c-Cre Cebpb(fl/fl) bone-marrow DCs sorted into the top and bottom 10% of CD86, one library per bin, as in Supplementary Data 11. MAGeCK in the paper compares Low with High (Cd86 is the top positive gene), so CD86-low versus CD86-high is the contrast; the unsorted library is not used. One library per bin: no-replicate path with the overdispersion pooled over all guides (no controls), so calls are screening-level and conservative.
